additionalProperties.comment: Build DRAM resource HOBs, load DXE and prepare its stack, then enter DXE with the HOB list. Takes base in r0:r1 and length in r2:r3. Returns 0x80000009 if preparation fails or DXE returns.
additionalProperties.name: PrepareDramResourcesAndEnterDxe

additionalProperties.comment: Initialize the HOB handoff and end markers at base for the supplied physical memory range. Takes base in r0:r1 and length in r2:r3, stores the HOB pointer globally, and returns zero.
additionalProperties.name: InitializeHobMemoryRange

additionalProperties.comment: Initialize hardware, detect boot mode and DRAM range, build the HOB list, then prepare DXE. Returns 0x80000009 if startup returns. Same code as 2.0.4 after rebasing PreEfi by -8 bytes; no new hardware gate.
additionalProperties.name: InitializePreEfiBootMemory

additionalProperties.comment: ARM handoff: save the entry from r0 in LR, set SP from r2, move the HOB pointer from r1 to r0 and the zero argument from r3 to r1, then BX LR. Does not establish a return address.
additionalProperties.name: EnterDxeWithStack
additionalProperties.value: void EnterDxeWithStack(uint entry, uint hob, uint stack, uint zero)
